title: Your reply
reasonPlaceholder: E.g. too formal, I am on first-name terms with this client
reasonHint: Optional. Your next proposals with this prompt take it into account; the administrators can read it to improve the prompt.
saveDraftTitle: Files the reply in the Drafts folder of your mailbox, without sending it
noKey: No OpenRouter key configured: add one in <link>Settings</link> to get proposals.
noPrompt: No prompt available: ask an administrator to create one.
placeholder: Write your reply, or just a few notes on what to say.
typosTitle: Corrects spelling and grammar, and changes nothing else. The email received is not sent to the AI.
styleTitle: Rewrites for clarity and tone, keeping the meaning. The email received is not sent to the AI.
applyPromptTitle: Writes the reply from the email received and from what you wrote, in the way this prompt describes.
confirmSendText: It leaves from your mailbox right away and cannot be taken back.
helpNote: Typos and style work on your text only: the email received is not sent to the AI.
toComplete: {count, plural, one {# passage in square brackets is still to complete.} other {# passages in square brackets are still to complete.}}
closedNone: No reply is expected: the reply area stays closed until you ask for it.
closedIgnored: This email is ignored: the reply area stays closed until you ask for it.
